name: Hinomori Shuka
source:
Young lady of the Hinomori family, and a student.

She is the daughter of [url=/c156624]Kohaku[/url], but their relationship is strained and they have grown distant. She is the picture of a refined, elegant young lady, yet possesses abundant drive and curiosity.

Perhaps out of rebellion against her mother, she offers to help search for [url=/c156628]Masaaki[/url]'s pledge document.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1343034]Getchu[/url]]
